name: Harpy
descr: A fierce and foul-smelling bird with an eight-foot wingspan and the upper body and face of a human.

data.motivesAndTactics: Defend nest, drop enemies from a great height, maraud from the air, screech incessantly

features.name: Toxic Aura
features.text: The Harpy emits a foul stench that renders all non-Harpies _Vulnerable_ while within Very Close range.

features.name: Swooping Attack
features.text: **Mark a Stress** to have the Harpy move in a straight line to a point within Far range and make an attack against a target in the Harpy's path. On a success, the Harpy deals **3d6** physical damage.
